newsitem.title: USA: Isidore fades to depression far from land.
newsitem.headline: Isidore fades to depression far from land.

text.p: The weather system named Isidore faded to tropical depression status on Tuesday as it swirled in the Atlantic Ocean far from land, the National Hurricane Center said.

At 11:00 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT), the depression's center was near latitude 34.8 north and longitude 40.3 west, or about 780 miles (1,255 km) west-southwest of the Azores and moving north near 23 mph (37 kph).

Maximum sustained winds were near 35 mph (55 kph), making the system, once a powerful Category 3 hurricane, a tropical depression. Forecasters said Isidore was likely to lose its tropical characteristics altogether on Tuesday as it moved northward over cooler waters.
